title: Review of the thermals flow-heredity finding: replicates on fresh seeds 21 and 22 (424/424 daughters keep the parent's kind, 0 conversions in 1247 tracks; the favoured kind takes 28-32 of 29-33 caps in both signs, neutral twin 12-15 each)
summary: heredity.py and world.py copied unchanged, seeds 21 and 22, T=800, eps +0.1, -0.1 and 0: daughters of the parent's kind at 86/86, 62/62, 50/50 (seed 21) and 90/90, 74/74, 62/62 (seed 22) persistent splits after labelling; tracks >= 20 t that flip kind 0 of 1247; median cap purity 0.90-0.95; final caps a:b 32:0 and 31:0 with eps +0.1, 1:28 and 5:28 with eps -0.1, 14:12 and 12:15 in the neutral twin. labkit re-run of the eps +0.1 world on seed 21: 47 persistent splits, generation 8, merge/split 0.13; the sheet shows two-coloured caps from the half-box labelling and kind b (green) vanishing by t~700.

observations.H: summary.txt: daughters keep the kind at 424/424 splits, 0 conversions in 1247 tracks; eps +0.1 fixes a (32:0, 31:0), eps -0.1 fixes b (1:28, 5:28), eps 0 stays mixed (14:12, 12:15) on seeds 21 and 22

controls_run.H: eps 0 twin and the sign-reversed eps -0.1 arm on the same seeds (h_s2*_e0.json, h_s2*_e-0.1.json)

verdicts.limitation: As the finding says, the kinds are planted at t=200 (half-box labelling), so this is heredity and selection between seeded kinds; the fitness effect is written into the heat yield. The caps' motion is buoyant rise in imposed gravity (20261027T0534-c53-audit-thermals). Split counts are heredity.py's own segmentation at 1-t frames. Two seeds, T=800, one parameter point.
